scripts.deploy:portfolio: npx cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/Portfolio-Website next build && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('out/.nojekyll', '')" && gh-pages --dotfiles -d out -b gh-pages -r https://github.com/aniketdede/Portfolio-Website.git
scripts.deploy:webdev: npx cross-env NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH=/WEB-DEVELOPEMENT next build && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('out/.nojekyll', '')" && gh-pages --dotfiles -d out -b gh-pages -r https://github.com/aniketdede/WEB-DEVELOPEMENT.git
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:portfolio && npm run deploy:webdev
